AllStar Hazard-Aware Navigation System
CS3A Mini Project 2026

HOW TO RUN:
1. Go into the "dist" folder
2. Double-click Run.bat

Note:
- Requires Java 21
- Some JavaFX warnings may appear in the console — they are normal and harmless.
- Demo Map is the fastest way to test.

Features:
- Custom KNN Terrain Classification (25D features)
- A*, Dijkstra, Greedy Best-First Search
- Dynamic blocking & interactive training
- Rich visualisation

Submitted by AllStar Team
